網媒《胡‧說樓市》周五（2日）報道指，赤柱 One Stanley 一幢逾億元獨立屋鋼筋質量出問題，分析部分位置鋼筋數量較批准圖則少約 41% 至 75%。屋宇署周六（3日）表示獲舉報，檢驗後發現地面低層一條橫樑保護層沒按圖則配置鋼絲網，部分樓板鋼筋配置與圖則不符。《胡‧說樓市》報道指，發展商建灝地產曾發律師信，要求暫緩、停止發布報道，表示「若未經證實的指控影響項目銷售，將保留追究法律責任的權利」。One Stanley 的賣方堅維有限公司昨晚發聲明表示，高度重視並會嚴肅跟進，如調查後發現有任何失誤，必根據法律向受影響物業進行補救，及追究有關人士責任。

發展商建灝地產　承建商海悅建築

赤柱黃麻角道 128 號，是低密度豪宅，整個樓盤只 82 伙，包括 32 幢洋房及 11 座分層住宅。發展商是建灝地產、承建商是中國建築興業的附屬公司海悅建築工程。建灝地產在 2013 年成立，創辦人羅家駒、羅建一父子，是 Bossini 家族後人。

《胡‧說樓市》跟進事件逾半年，報道指，單位的業主在 2024 年 4 月購入單位，去年 8 月裝修時，發現部分樓板表層混凝土異常，二樓主人房地台以下部分批盪表層剝離，其後發現鋼筋「走位」、間距不一。

報道指，屋宇署進行掃描及拆除檢測後，業主委聘的註冊結構工程師根據屋宇署數據分析，指二樓書房部分位置的主鋼筋數量較批准圖則少約 41% 至 75%；一樓睡房天花部分位置少約 42% 至 57.9%。

屋宇署 2023 年 7 月發「入伙紙」

屋宇署回應《胡‧說樓市》的報道表示，接獲舉報後一直嚴肅跟進調查。屋宇署指，該獨立屋在 2023 年 7 月獲發「入伙紙」，業主買入後裝修。屋宇署在今年一月接獲業主代表舉報屋內樓板結構安全問題，三月到場視察後，認為整體樓宇結構沒明顯危險。署方去信要求項目註冊結構工程師提交相關物料測試報告和證明書等資料。

屋宇署：部分樓板鋼筋配置與圖則不符

屋宇署指，今年六至九月多次視察，進行混凝土強度反彈錘敲測試、面層測厚儀勘測、表面雷達勘測鋼筋配置、鑽芯抗壓測試，以及現場開鑿檢驗，正分析數據。屋宇署表示，測試及檢驗發現，該獨立屋地面低層一條橫樑的保護層沒按圖則配置鋼絲網；此外，部分樓板的鋼筋配置與圖則不符。

去信發展商等要求協助調查

屋宇署指這些情況「未有構成明顯危險」，會進一步調查。署方已去信有關項目的發展商、承建商、認可人士、註冊結構工程師，要求協助調查。屋宇署提醒業界，根據《建築物條例》，建築專業人士及承建商必須按照批准圖則監工和施工。署方又指，若調查後發現有建築專業人士及承建商違反《建築物條例》，定會嚴肅跟進，包括提出檢控，及、或展開紀律處分行動。

賣方：掌握及核實更多資料後適時交代

One Stanley 的賣方堅維有限公司回應指，高度重視並會嚴肅跟進。該公司指，根據屋宇署發布資料，屋宇署認為物業整體樓宇結構沒明顯危險。堅維表示，正詳細了解及核實，會盡力配合屋宇署調查，掌握及核實更多資料後適時交代。如調查後發現有任何人士於施工質量或其他相關事項失誤，必根據法律法規向受影響物業進行補救，並依法追究有關人士責任。

擁有逾300年歷史嘅油塘茶果嶺村清拆在即，近半地方已夷為平地，居民大多搬遷，村內嘅榮華冰室、開記（協和）冰室今（4日）最後一日營業。不少市民一早到場光顧，大排長龍。有熟客帶同寫有祝福語嘅月曆送畀兩間冰室嘅老闆；不少「文青」以菲林相機留下最後記錄；顧客「埋單」時要求老闆手寫收據作留念；亦有顧客帶紙同筆即場寫生。

「招待最後一位客先拉閘」

榮華冰室嘅老闆鏡叔因身體不適，今日冇親自「睇鋪」，最後一日由女兒阿雪同三位夥計打理，阿雪表示「去到最後都有心嚟捧場，真係多謝晒。」開記（協和）冰室老闆鍾叔同老闆娘忙得不可開交，而且到場支持嘅大多為熟客，鍾叔豪氣噉話：「今日不設關門時間，招待最後一位客先拉閘。」

1962年開業至今嘅榮華冰室，石屋牆身，內部以鐵皮同瓷磚鋪砌，舊式通花鐵閘，鐵閘上有手寫紅字嘅鐵信箱。店內座無虛席，阿雪同三位夥計來來回回，西多士一碟接一碟；全店八張枱，食客多叫奶茶、西多士，亦有啲會叫餐蛋麵。

坐喺角落嘅周先生食咗一口西多士，話：「啱啱出爐好食啲」。周先生住將軍澳，因朋友推介第一次到榮華冰室，佢話被冰室嘅風味吸引，最欣賞嘅就係由右至左嘅紅字招牌。

 

60年秘方西多

阿雪一邊接受傳媒訪問，一旁嘅夥計大叫「邊個叫西多？」然後又對另一枱食客話「下一碟到你」。有記者問阿雪西多士嘅做法，阿雪提高音量話「呢啲60年秘方就唔講啦，反正就最好食㗎啦」。阿雪表示，上午9時半開店時門外已有人流，今日將營業至晚上七時，77歲嘅鏡叔會喺結業後退休。

「有返當年舊香港嘅感覺」

黃小姐一家光顧七年，今早10時半已經到場排隊。佢哋一家住喺將軍澳，光顧已有七年，食嘅係「年代感」，黃先生話：「相比起𠵱家啲連鎖餐廳，佢有返當年舊香港嘅感覺，佢比到一種本土冰室嘅感覺，我覺得其他地方已經冇保留到呢種特色。」

舊冰室嘅人情味

梁小姐住喺藍田，兩年前得知茶果嶺村即將清拆，便一直光顧兩間舊冰室至今，今日中午佢帶兩個寫上祝福語嘅月曆送畀老闆們，祝願身體健康，而且月曆年份為2027，寓意仍有新嘅盼望。

梁小姐之前有將具特別意義嘅雨傘遺留喺榮華冰室，兩週後佢再次光顧，鏡叔不但保留雨傘，仲親自歸還畀佢；佢話亦有次開記（協和）冰室老闆娘聽見佢話「凍檸茶好飲」，即場多送一杯畀佢；佢形容呢種舊冰室嘅人情味「好似自己阿爺阿嫲對自己咁」。

鍾叔：今日不設關門時間，招待最後一位客先拉閘

榮華冰室對面，係1950年代開業至今嘅開記（協和）冰室，老闆鍾叔坐喺收銀枱，顧客埋單時輪流合照，仲要求鍾叔手寫收據作留念。收銀枱枱上有幾封信，係熟客得知開記（協和）結業後寫畀鍾叔嘅，字裏行間都係對老闆人情味嘅謝意，收銀枱嘅櫃裏仲有幾幅畫，亦係熟客送嘅，鍾叔得意噉向記者逐張展示。

冰室結業　正式退休

今日不少熟客捧場，近80歲嘅鍾叔忙得不可開交，一邊食住冰室招牌嘅梅菜扣肉飯做午餐，一邊收銀，一邊應付食客合照嘅要求。鍾叔表示以往冰室逢星期日及公眾假期都會休息，不過今日將不設關門時間，堅持招待最後一位客先至拉落鐵閘。佢話冰室結業後將不再工作，正式退休。

自從 Jony Ive 於 2019 年離開 Apple 以來，公司一直欠缺一位真正的設計主管。有一段時間，前營運總監 Jeff Williams 曾負責設計事務，直至他去年離職。此後，行政總裁 John Ternus 對 Apple 旗下兩大設計團隊——工業設計及人機介面——均展現出高度重視，據 Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 報道。

這個故事其實早於 John Ternus 出任行政總裁之前已經開始，後者上任至今僅約一個月。事件的起點是 Jeff Williams 卸任營運總監一職。當時公司宣布這些團隊將向前任行政總裁 Tim Cook 匯報，但據報實際上是由 John Ternus 負責。這是他過渡至行政總裁期間的其中一項重要職責。

Ternus 對設計深感興趣其實毫不令人意外，畢竟他過去主管硬件工程。然而 Gurman 形容 Ternus 的參與程度為「全情投入」，並指他經常親身到訪與團隊一同工作：

這與前行政總裁 Tim Cook 形成強烈對比——據 Bloomberg 指出，Tim Cook 每月只到訪設計工作室大約一次。

Ternus 全情投入 Apple 設計團隊

Ternus 亦投放大量心力填補設計團隊的空缺，因為公司不少人才已被外部企業挖角。最矚目的是 Alan Dye 跳槽至 Meta，而 OpenAI 亦從 Apple 挖走不少員工。為重新激活團隊，Apple 已晉升多位年輕設計師，並從外間招攬新血。

雖然 Ternus 缺乏傳統的設計背景，但他對設計的投入意味著一件事：設計將繼續在 Apple 最高決策層佔據核心地位。

姬絲花・羅絲・布蘭莎（Gypsy Rose Blanchard）表示，其未婚夫肯・烏克（Ken Urker）因服藥過量身亡，並暗示網絡欺凌可能是導致他死亡的原因。

烏克於星期四在其34歲生日當天，於路易斯安那州雷克蘭（Raceland）的寓所床上離世。布蘭莎星期五接受《人物》雜誌訪問時表示，她不知道對方是否有意為之，但稱他「近來精神狀態欠佳」。

拉福什縣（Lafourche Parish）警長辦公室未有即時回應查詢，但他們告訴《人物》雜誌，警方於星期四下午6時15分接報到場，到達時發現烏克已經死亡。

布蘭莎指烏克是網絡騷擾的受害者，並向《人物》雜誌表示，她相信這些騷擾對他造成了「深遠的影響」。

星期日，她分享了一條連結，呼籲制定一項法例，要求社交媒體平台就其處理騷擾投訴的手法承擔責任。她將該法命名為「Kenan法」，以烏克的名字命名。

布蘭莎在請願書中寫道：「肯是公眾人物，承受了大量來自公眾的審視目光。在TikTok、Instagram、YouTube及Reddit等平台上，充斥大量關於他的內容，我們認為這些內容已超越批評的界線，演變為針對性的騷擾和網絡欺凌。」

她表示，自己和烏克均曾就騷擾作出投訴，但社交媒體平台多次回覆指並無違規。

布蘭莎寫道：「Kenan法將要求立法者為主要社交媒體平台處理嚴重及重複出現的網絡騷擾投訴訂立更完善的程序。」

布蘭莎於2016年成為新聞焦點，當時她因謀殺母親蒂・迪・布蘭莎（Dee Dee Blanchard）而被判監10年。案件後來揭發，蒂・迪・布蘭莎患有代理型孟喬森症候群（Munchausen syndrome by proxy），這種精神疾病令她捏造女兒的各種健康問題，但事實上女兒的身體一直正常。姬絲花・羅絲當時的男友最終殺害了蒂・迪。

姬絲花・羅絲於2022年7月在服刑期間與賴恩・安德森（Ryan Anderson）結婚，但不足一年便宣布離婚，其後與烏克訂婚，並於2024年12月誕下一名孩子。

劏房普查．港島｜灣仔獲認證簡樸房月租近萬　業主：以前唔敢話畀人聽　北角昔日豪宅業主申寬限無意認證

劏房普查．港島｜母子居 200 呎劏房　業主租約到期前提加租千元　劏房攻陷銅鑼灣、中環、西半山

Today (the 5th) is the United Nations World Habitat Day. This year's theme is adequate housing for all. In Hong Kong, what is the situation? The "Subdivided Flat Support Alliance" published a survey report titled "The Impact of Simple Flat Regulation on Subdivided Flat Residents." In the early stage of the legislation's implementation, that is, from March 2 to June 23 this year, 647 valid samples were collected through snowball sampling (through participant referrals). Respondents mainly came from areas including Tsuen Wan, Kwai Tsing, Tuen Mun, and Yau Tsim Mong, with the great majority currently living in subdivided flats, bedspace, industrial building sub-divided units, unauthorized structures, wooden huts, or squatter huts — all inadequate housing.

劏房未達規管標準

The survey found that 35.4% of the households lived in units that failed at least one requirement of simple flats, while 11.7% had two or more non-compliant items, with unit area of less than 8 square metres (86 square feet) being the most common. The group is worried that the relevant units may not successfully obtain certification, and residents may face risks of renovation, rent increases, contract termination, or even relocation.

估計 2027 年 9 月迫遷高峰期

Regarding tenancies, more than a hundred households have physical written leases that will expire between 2026 and 2028, coinciding with the transition from the simple flat registration period to the enforcement stage. The group estimates that September 2027 will be the peak of the "eviction tide." In addition, nearly one-third of renewing tenants have been asked to pay higher rent, utilities, or other miscellaneous fees.

The group stated that as the grace period draws to a close, if renovation and certification are not completed, landlords may tend to shorten the lease term, or even avoid long leases, to retain flexibility for future renovation or withdrawal from the market. Some landlords may pass on renovation and certification costs to renters, making things even harder for grassroots families.

劏房戶「向下流」

In addition, 30 households were notified by landlords in the past year that they needed to move out, or were affected by unit renovations. Another 59 households had moved in the past year, of which 54 households still lived in inadequate housing after moving, and 19 of them moved into industrial building sub-divided units, unauthorized structures, wooden huts, or squatter huts, among others. The group pointed out that this reflects that when grassroots families face eviction or rent pressure, they "can only flow from one form of inadequate housing to another."

From a subdivided flat to a "one cut into eleven" industrial building unit with no windows

Ms. Tang, who works in cleaning, originally rented a "one cut into four" subdivided flat unit in Tsuen Wan; her unit was about 100 square feet with a window, with monthly rent at about $4,000, but two of the units inside the flat were about 60 to 70 square feet and had no windows, failing to meet the simple flat standard. After living there for five years, the 70-year-old landlord said he was worried about the regulation, "I'm old, I don't want to throw a sum of money on renovation," and simply sold the property.

Ms. Tang moved within two months, into a "one cut into eleven" industrial building unit, with monthly rent plus utilities at about $4,000, less than 100 square feet. She said that because the unit has no windows and the air is not circulated, she often feels dizzy when she wakes up in the morning and has seen a Chinese medicine doctor for eight months; after closing the door and turning off the lights at night, the room is completely dark; the wooden boards are moldy, the floor has leaked water, and the nearby lunchbox factory also makes noise in the morning.

Industrial building units are not covered by the simple flat regulation, but converting them for residential use already violates the Buildings Ordinance. She pointed out that open flames are not allowed in the unit, so she only dares to blanch vegetables, not to fry fish or stir-fry. Last year, a firefighter inspected the industrial building, but Ms. Tang had already gone to work at the time. She said she was not worried about being discovered running an illegal subdivided flat, "They probably can't catch anyone, everyone keeps their door shut."

She recalled that she had previously rented a tin-sheet loft unit, which was stifling hot in summer, and now the industrial building sub-divided unit is just as bad. She once shed tears, saying she did not want her family to know she was "so unlucky." With a monthly income of $13,000 to $13,500, she just slightly exceeds the public rental housing income limit and cannot apply for public housing. She hopes to move out as soon as possible, wishing for a new unit with windows and air circulation.

葵涌劏房單親母被迫遷

May, a single mother over 50 years old with three children, lives with her family in a Kwai Chung "one cut into two" subdivided flat with two rooms and one hall, about 200 square feet, with monthly rent plus utilities at about $9,000. May said she had lived in a squatter hut for 11 years. After falling and injuring her knee while walking up a hundred steps, she stopped working; her second daughter, who carried a heavy school bag up the hundred steps, developed scoliosis of 129 degrees and needed surgery with 20 screws implanted.

已輪候過渡性房屋一年多

As a result, she decided to move, and moved into her current subdivided flat over a year ago. May said that because there is an elevator and it is near the station, it is convenient to take care of her second daughter, carrying her school bag for her every day. In July this year, she suddenly received a notice from the landlord that due to the simple flat regulation, the unit had to be reclaimed for renovation, and she had four months to move out. Similar subdivided flats in the same district have risen to over $10,000 in rent, while the government rent allowance is only $6,000, which cannot cover the cost, and the children are reluctant to move. She said she has been waiting for transitional housing for over a year, only hoping to be rehoused in the same district for the convenience of her children's schooling and medical appointments.

團體憂遷入更隱蔽、危險房屋市場

Regarding the implementation of simple flats, Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho earlier this month said that of the 110,000 sub-divided units in Hong Kong, about 73,800 simple flat registrations have been received, accounting for about 68% of the total, with 42 units certified. However, Lai Kin-kwok, a member of the "Subdivided Flat Support Alliance," questioned that over 30,000 units have still not been registered, reflecting that landlords are "holding back" and waiting, or considering withdrawing from the market or restoring the units.

「用生命搏個租金」

He is worried that after converting to compliant simple flats, rents will inevitably rise, turning to attract mainland Chinese students to rent, "At least renting for $7,000 or $8,000 or more, those renting for $5,000 can't get in," making it unaffordable for grassroots households, who will eventually move to more hidden and dangerous places such as industrial buildings, squatter huts, rooftop huts, or New Territories container houses, where the fire risk is higher. He described it as "fighting for the rent with one's life."

Among the approximately 30,000 light public housing units, about 10,000 units are located in Kai Tak.

預計「地下房屋」將進一步擴張

He predicts that as the grace period ends, underground housing will further expand, and unless one actively knocks on doors, it will be difficult to reach these residents. He suggested incorporating industrial buildings, squatter huts, and village houses into regulation, and properly handling the rehousing after eviction, such as referring to the "place-purchase" model used for elderly care homes to rehouse residents.

He also noted that some landlords are using "co-tenancy" arrangements to avoid regulation, with landlords telling tenants "either you co-tenant, or I raise your rent." However, tenants have low bargaining power and are forced to accept; the risk is that if the co-tenant runs away, the tenant has to bear the full rent.

五年規劃未提過渡屋　憂北都「開荒」

Lai Kin-kwok also noted that this year's Policy Address proposed Hong Kong's first five-year plan, stating that the problem of poor-quality subdivided flats in residential buildings will be basically solved by 2030, but the long-term positioning of transitional housing is not mentioned; even though housing will be built in the Northern Metropolis, the surrounding infrastructure is currently incomplete, and he is worried about a repeat of the "pioneering" situation in Tuen Mun and Yuen Long back then, with residents "possibly having to endure for ten years," which is unfair to grassroots households.

When the housing in the Northern Metropolis is first completed, the group is worried that the surrounding infrastructure is currently incomplete and fears a repeat of the "pioneering" situation in Tuen Mun and Yuen Long back then.

蔡母指鄺港智18歲搬入同住 女兒不久懷孕產子

控方接著傳召蔡天鳳母親張燕花作供，鄺球皺眉抿嘴、鄺港傑亦皺眉。蔡母提到自己在第一任婚姻下、在海南誕下蔡天鳳，之後離婚，在蔡天鳳三歲時認識蔡父，當時他經營三間酒樓、家景富裕。蔡母形容第二任丈夫與蔡天鳳關係「好好」，家庭關係密切，到2004年，丈夫結束香港的酒樓生意並到海南經商，每個月會給「過百萬」家用予她和三名女兒生活；又提及蔡父經常給錢女兒投資，「咁耐都起碼過千萬」，而女兒主要是透過買股票賺錢。

蔡母指女兒中學就讀弘爵國際學校，學業「一般咁樣」，亦是在學校內認識了鄺港智，在15歲時曾帶同學、包括鄺港智回家食飯，二人拍拖後知悉鄺父「揸的士」，母親和哥哥都沒有工作，又指鄺港智沒提及鄺父曾為沙展。

蔡母之後指二人拍拖後，鄺港智18歲時搬到家中同住，之後不久蔡天鳳便懷孕。主控問到對蔡母而言是喜事抑或會擔心，蔡母指「佢話有咗，咁佢兩個都話，Alex話好愛囡囡、Abby，佢（蔡天鳳）話死啦仲返緊學，點算」。蔡母引述鄺港智稱很愛女兒，於是她向二人稱既然相愛，便邊懷孕邊讀書，「生出嚟媽咪養囉」。蔡天鳳誕下長子不久後再度懷孕，蔡母指自己鼓勵她繼續讀書，跟女兒說「媽咪幫你湊幫你養」。

蔡天鳳父親繼續到庭旁聽。今日由蔡母張燕花作供，講述女兒與鄺家一家人的關係。

供稱鄺家「無錢」　不曾經濟上照顧孫兒

蔡母指二人誕下女兒後，便搬到附近的另一單位居住，有工人照顧；蔡母提及工人由他們僱用「奶粉一罐佢哋都無買到架」，又指鄺港智一直沒有工作，而鄺球和太太偶爾會探望孫兒，又指鄺家「梗係無錢架啦。從來都無買過奶粉、無畀過一蚊錢畀個孫」。

蔡天鳳和鄺港智2015年分開，蔡母形容與鄺的關係仍然「好好」，不時聯繫，「再見亦是朋友嘛，有細路仔」，又指鄺家亦與女兒「冇嘢」、「都係好好咁樣聯繫」，又指兩個家庭關係友好，「全屋企成日一起食飯」、疫情期間更每天到蔡家吃飯，又會一起到海南旅行。控方問到即使蔡天鳳未有前往旅行，是否仍會替鄺家支付費用？蔡母指女兒「畀好多好多錢佢呢一家人」、又指「全家都係使個女嘅錢」，形容「真係關係好好架，有求必應，幫佢哋多架啦」；鄺球聞言冷笑。

鄺港智在2015年底涉詐騙案未有上庭，蔡母指不清楚案件詳情，而此後他大部分時留在內地，亦是由女兒支付生活費用，蔡母指因雙方關係友好、他亦是兩個孫兒的父親，又指「佢好識氹我，好識講嘢架」。

雙方承認事實提到案發當日，由鄺港傑駕駛AA3383的白色七人車接載蔡天鳳，於同日下午3時11分停泊在龍尾村村屋外。早前播放的CCTV片段顯示，鄺球、鄺港智從車上搬運疑載有蔡天鳳的膠箱入屋；有關車輛其後被警方檢走搜證。

指譚家婚後 「最少畀三億幾阿女」

2016年底，蔡天鳳在未正式與鄺港智離婚下，與譚方駿舉行婚宴。蔡母在控方提問下，同意女兒和譚事實上是夫妻，並確認結婚時譚方駿的父親，送了價值約4200萬元的物業予女兒。而到2019年女兒購買加多利山豪宅，亦是譚父付款，給蔡與鄺的子女住、亦當作是投資「價錢好都賣」。蔡母指女兒視鄺家為一家人，由於女兒已持有物業，如再買樓要付900多萬元印花稅，故把物業登記在鄺球名下，強調兩家曾討論有關安排，她亦在場。

控方問及是否有其他人支付物業費用，蔡母重申是譚家支付，指譚父曾開出8000萬元的支票給女兒；她又提到女兒和譚方駿結婚後，「陸陸續續畀阿女都有億幾兩億」、「譚家最少畀三億幾呀女」。蔡母強調單位「冇可能」是送給鄺球，又指當時相信鄺球在有需時會交回單位，引述他曾說「時時都配合架啦」。

指鄺球拒出售加多利山物業 通話時「要打要殺」

蔡母之後提及蔡天鳳和鄺家的關係，在2022年6月後生變。她指蔡天鳳當時打算賣掉加多利山豪宅，搬屋方便將轉校的女兒，致電鄺球提出後雙方爭執，又自己曾介入，「六月份，啊女打話同佢傾，佢唔肯，全家都唔肯，跟著我打（電話），都係唔肯，要打要殺」。蔡母指曾與鄺港智、鄺母溝通，控方追問是誰人提及要打要殺，蔡母指是鄺球，指他「唔肯交層樓出嚟」；鄺球聞言皺眉、抿嘴。

蔡母供稱，由於鄺球不願配合，女兒遂叫在內地生活的鄺港智回港，又指鄺港智繼續向女兒「攞錢」，她和女兒的反應相似，「我話攞咗咁多啦，唔可以再攞啦」、「阿女話幾年都無賺過、生活費都無賺過返嚟」。蔡母指鄺港智多年來從蔡天鳳處取得7000多萬元，指他聲稱轉售名錶賺錢，並會將所得拆帳予長子，但結果蔡「冇攞過一蚊，本都冇埋」。由於雙方關係生變，她勸女兒不要再給錢予鄺港智，而他對此感憤怒。

指以偷錢為由要蔡天鳳炒司機　另向司機謊稱全家旅遊

根據雙方承認事實，案發當日，由鄺港傑駕駛AA3383白色七人車，接載蔡天鳳、鄺港智前往接女兒放學。控方早前開案陳詞提及，鄺港智在車上向蔡施襲後，鄺港傑將車駛往龍尾村村屋，與由鄺球駕駛的另一輛七人車一頭一尾停泊，CCTV片段顯示鄺港傑和鄺球從車上，搬運疑載有蔡天鳳的膠箱入屋。

控方今向蔡母問到司機安排。蔡母供稱2022年約11月、即案發前約三個月，鄺港智母親（註：李瑞芳，因涉隱瞞鄺港智行蹤被控意圖妨礙司法公正，判刑18個月）向蔡天鳳指，原本駕駛AA3383的司機阿信（音譯）「又偷錢又借錢，叫Abby炒咗呢個阿信」，又指鄺港傑「冇嘢做」。蔡母續稱，女兒最初不欲解僱司機、又指鄺港傑非正式司機，鄺母於是出糧予司機、謊稱全家要旅遊三個月，著其可暫停工作，「佢阿哥又夾硬要做，話無嘢做，你畀我做，做得唔好先炒」，鄺港傑遂在2023年1月接任。蔡天鳳最終於2023年2月遇害。

聆訊明日待續，蔡母將繼續作供。

網媒《胡·說樓市》上周五報道，赤柱 One Stanley 一間逾億元的獨立屋，鋼筋數量與圖則不符，部分位置鋼筋數量，較圖則少約 41%至 75%。涉事獨立屋 2023 年獲屋宇署發入伙紙。究竟入伙紙是如何批出？監察機制為何？屋苑其他單位，屋宇署應否作出檢查？資深結構工程師倪學仁說：「好明顯就監工嗰方面有問題」，如循《建築物條例》，事件與承建商、地盤委派檢驗工程人員關係密切。此外，署方上周六指，視察後認為整體樓宇結構「沒明顯危險」。倪學仁指，這不表示佢長遠品質不會有問題，如遇火災或有更大機會倒塌。《集誌社》正向屋宇署查詢，為何會批出入伙紙、會否作全屋苑檢驗等，正待回覆。

入伙紙究竟是如何發出？

屋宇署上周六表示，該獨立屋在 2023 年 7 月獲發「入伙紙」，業主買入後正為單位進行裝修。署方在今年一月接獲業主代表舉報，三月到場視察，認為整體樓宇結構沒有明顯危險。六月至九月視察、檢驗，發現地面低層一條橫樑保護層沒有按圖則配置鋼絲網，部分樓板的鋼筋配置與圖則不符。入伙紙究竟是如何發出？

認可人士等證明　屋宇署對圖則

工程師倪學仁指，坊間所指的「入伙紙」，是屋宇署的「表格 13 - 建成新建築物的建築工程竣工證明書及申請佔用該建築物的許可證」，該表格一般由承建商聯同註冊承建商、註冊結構工程師、註冊岩土工程師、認可人士，向屋宇署申請證明該建築完工並可佔用，以證明建築物符合圖則興建、建築物料等，屋宇署派員實地度呎檢查屋宇是否符合圖則後，再批出「入伙紙」。

署方一般主要信賴地盤註冊檢驗人員

倪學仁說，《建築物條例》下採取委派註冊人員檢測監管，今次事件是鋼筋埋在混凝土磚下，屋宇署人員一般不會檢查。《胡·說樓市》報道中，屋宇署針對全間屋作非破壞性掃描也非恆常做法。

「60 年前、70 年前嘅嘢，點會喺𠵱家出現？」

倪學仁指，署方一般主要信賴地盤註冊檢驗人員，最後卻發現「鋼筋搭到亂晒籠」，「60 年前、70 年前嘅嘢，點會喺𠵱家出現？」。他強調現時鐵筋價值低，認為未必涉及成本問題，原因有待調查，主責仍在承建商以及地盤所委任的檢驗工程師，「變咗佢哋做咗虛假陳述。」

「好明顯就監工嗰方面有問題。」

倪學仁認為，屋宇署責任是批出圖則並要求指定專業人士監工，「𠵱家就要睇吓邊個層次有甩漏，好明顯就監工嗰方面有問題。」

可跟從《建築物條例》進入其他單位檢查

事件曝光後，屋宇署指「整體樓宇結構沒有明顯危險」。倪學仁表示，鋼筋排列雖可按圖則要求或比例調整，但同時要滿足消防要求，「所謂無明顯危險，係無即時危險，並不表示佢長遠品質、質量情況係唔會有問題。」

他舉例，如現時有人站在缺少鋼筋處不會即時倒塌，但火災時如其他鋼筋被燒熔或有更大機會倒塌，以至加重業主日後維修石屎剝落成本，「我哋要求就係火燭時都唔冧得⋯⋯原本你層樓可能用 100 年都無事，𠵱家變咗可能 30 年就要打走佢，再做過都未定」。倪說，署方如懷疑建築與圖則不符，亦可跟從《建築物條例》進入其他單位檢查。

《胡‧說樓市》跟進事件逾半年，上周五報道指，單位的業主在 2024 年 4 月購入單位，去年 8 月裝修時，發現部分樓板表層混凝土異常，二樓主人房地台以下部分批盪表層剝離，其後發現鋼筋「走位」、間距不一。

報道指屋宇署進行掃描及拆除檢測後，業主委聘的註冊結構工程師，根據屋宇署數據分析，指二樓書房部分位置的主鋼筋數量，較批准圖則少約 41% 至 75%；一樓睡房天花部分位置，少約 42% 至 57.9%。

可如何補救？　最簡單是重建或加厚樓底

One Stanley 涉事單位為排屋結構，倪學仁指，排屋通常涉及共用結構，假如兩棟獨立屋之間的樓梯結構相連，鄰近單位一樣會受牽連，具體情況視圖則而定。

單位部分地方的鋼筋，估計最多較圖則少 75%，可如何補救？倪學仁說，最簡單的解決方法是重建或加厚樓底，但時間、成本、加上已有買家，對方是否接受屬買賣雙方糾紛。

海悅辦公室為中國建築興業寫字樓　職員指海悅沒直接聯絡

赤柱黃麻角道 128 號 One Stanley，是低密度豪宅，整個樓盤共有 82 伙，包括 32 幢洋房及 11 座共 52 伙分層住宅。發展商是建灝地產、承建商是中國建築興業的附屬公司海悅建築工程。

記者今早到過發展商建灝地產、總承建商海悅建築工程有限公司的辦公室。海悅辦公室為中國建築興業寫字樓，寫字樓職員接到門鈴後，要求記者留下聯絡方式時掛斷通話，再次按鐘已無人接聽；接待處職員則表示海悅沒有直接聯絡，要由中國建築興業聯絡。建灝地產的職員，則只著記者留下聯絡方式、容後再聯絡。

經歷過最後一天的人山人海，茶果嶺寮屋區今日（5日）正式踏入最終章。地政總署人員今早到場執行收地程序，多間見證社區變遷的數十年老店，正式畫上句號。

最後一天　留連至十時許才陸續散去

屹立茶果嶺七十多年的榮華冰室，東主鏡叔昨日因血壓低、常感頭暈，未能親身回到舖頭打「最後一仗」。「做咗咁多年，企住喺嗰度唔郁喎，腳底好痛，我企咗幾日，痛到我咩咁呀。」鏡叔新抱亦指，過去週末盛況空前，忙得不可開交，「早餐淨係食咗碗麥皮、飲吓水，就無停過。」昨晚顧客依依不捨，漫談昔日街坊情誼，留連至十時許才陸續散去。

榮華冰室鏡叔　返舖最後執拾

幸而，鏡叔今日血壓回升至約 120 的正常水平。他精神奕奕與家人返舖進行最後執拾，並簽署相關文件交鎖匙。面對特別到場見證冰室落幕的熱心市民，鏡叔連番致謝，更主動邀請大家合照，「希望留個紀念」。

開記（協和）鍾叔　忙至深夜十一時

另一邊廂，開記（協和）冰室的鍾叔昨晚同樣忙至深夜十一時。今早他趕忙收拾店內物件，除了深深不捨一班街坊，亦興奮地向在場人士分享昨日媒體對冰室的報道，更特意送出水牌、筷子等舊物，讓到場市民留念。

至於茂發茶室的華仔，最著緊的是店內的舊物與承諾。他早前已答應將部分舊物贈予有心市民，故今日特意向地政人員追問保安安排，坦言深怕被爆門而入、失信於人。

清拆前夕，亦有人專程來送別這片老社區。日裔港人 Sophie 指，自看過電影《緣路山旮旯》後，便跟隨導演導賞團到訪茶果嶺，發現榮華冰室極具懷舊氣息，此後不時前來品嚐西多士。知道剛過去的週末必定擠擁，她特意選在今日到場，親自向鏡叔道別。隨著最後的收拾與道別結束，茶果嶺老店歲月亦隨之謝幕。

宏福苑 owners have started flat selection since last week. Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho previously stated that 90.6% of owners have signed the Sale and Purchase Agreement, reminding owners that they must complete the signing before October 15. A legislator asked, with 10 days remaining until the 15th, how will the unfinished sale and purchase agreements be handled? Winnie Ho said that if owners show 'sincerity', the authorities will definitely show understanding and make flexible arrangements as much as possible. She also said that if owners show 'no intention to negotiate', they will be regarded as no longer accepting the acquisition plan, and legislation may be introduced in the future. As for some owners having to pay stamp duty amounting to six figures, Winnie Ho pointed out that the government's acquisition price is 30% higher than the market price, with relevant factors already taken into account, describing 'that 30% precisely addresses the 'reasonableness' aspect among reason, emotion, and law.'

Secretary for Housing Winnie Ho today (the 5th) attended the Legislative Council for a policy briefing. Federation of Trade Unions legislator Tang Ka-piu pointed out that recently, Wang Fuk Court owners have been selecting flats, and many reflected that the explainers 'did a great job' — familiar with the procedures and policies and showing empathy for the residents' needs. Tang Ka-piu asked, given that 99.3% of owners have accepted the acquisition and resettlement, with 10 days remaining, how will the authorities handle owners who have not signed by October 15? He also revealed that the case he is following involves a family hoping to accept the acquisition, but the original owner has passed away, court proceedings are underway, and they are 'very anxious.' He asked whether they can retain the right to select a flat if they cannot complete the process on time.

Winnie Ho (right) stated that if owners show 'sincerity' in completing the transaction, the authorities will show understanding and make flexible arrangements. As for owners who show 'no intention to negotiate', legislation may be introduced in the future. (File photo)

Winnie Ho stated that if owners show 'sincerity', flexible arrangements will be made as much as possible

Winnie Ho stated that the question is not directly related to the five-year plan and gave a brief response. She first praised the explainer team, saying 'the explainer team is indeed best able to help the residents,' because each of the more than 1,980 households has different circumstances and intentions. She said the explainers 'truly walk alongside each household,' understanding their difficulties or what information they need to make decisions, and hoped everyone would communicate more with the explainers.

She continued that October 15 is an important date, pointing out that there may be two situations after that date where the agreement cannot be completed. The first is when owners very much want to complete the transaction but are unable to sign documents due to different circumstances, such as sudden serious illness and hospitalisation. She said that as long as it is clear that the owners are sincere in completing the transaction and the reasons are beyond their control, 'we will definitely show understanding and definitely make flexible arrangements as much as possible.' The other situation is when 'they start showing no intention to negotiate,' or refuse to sign documents, fail to handle procedures, and 'have no such intention.' In this case, 'we will regard them as no longer accepting this acquisition plan, and our sale and purchase will be terminated.' Winnie pointed out that this group of people may be like the more than ten households who initially did not return their acceptance letters, which the government has mentioned multiple times, and legislation may need to be introduced in the future.

Many Wang Fuk Court owners have expressed that they are forced to change flats yet have to pay high stamp duty. Winnie Ho, when responding to legislators this time, said that when the government proposed an acquisition price 30% higher than the market price, the relevant factors had already been taken into account. (File photo)

Responding to large stamp duty — Winnie Ho points out 'the acquisition price is 30% more'

Tang Ka-piu further asked that some owners have selected more expensive projects in Kowloon Bay and Fanling, requiring payment of stamp duty in six figures, and asked 'is there anything that can ease this immediate financial burden?' He also mentioned that about 20 households in Wang Chi House have purchased home insurance, and pointed out that residents of the other seven blocks received sympathy from insurance companies after the fire and obtained relevant insurance compensation, but Wang Chi House has not received such assistance. He said, 'I hope the government can also help these residents of Wang Chi House.'

Winnie Ho did not respond to questions about Wang Chi House insurance. Regarding stamp duty, Winnie pointed out that the acquisition price is 30% higher than the market price, saying 'that 30% precisely addresses the 'reasonableness' aspect among reason, emotion, and law.' She also said that she had previously explained in the Legislative Council, 'this 30% understands that they may need to move, have some renovation costs, some legal fees, or stamp duty for buying and selling property... If that 30% has already taken these circumstances into account, then the stamp duty is also included within this consideration.' She added that the rental allowance will be extended until residents purchase their new units, and that Tung Wah Group of Hospitals also provides pro bono legal assistance.

Winnie also pointed out that in fact, many units are priced below HK$4 million, with nearly two-thirds of units having acquisition prices (without land premium having been paid) sufficient for owners to make their selection, and stamp duty for owners choosing such units is only HK$100. She said these all reflect that while balancing public resources, the authorities are doing their best to help residents, hoping they will soon have a place to call home.

喺科技史上，其中一段最出名兼最成功嘅合作關係，就係喺Steve Jobs同Jony Ive之間。Tim Cook接任CEO之後，並冇以同樣嘅角色同Ive一齊處理硬件設計——而呢個係正確嘅決定。

John Ternus睇嚟用咗一種更接近Steve嘅方式同Apple嘅設計部門合作，我認為呢個都係正確嘅選擇……

Apple好多最具代表性嘅設計，都係出自Steve Jobs同Jony Ive之間獨一無二嘅合作。兩人合作極為緊密，通常一日至少會見一次面，而出嚟嘅成果遠比任何一方單獨做到嘅更加出色。

兩人都想突破硬件設計嘅界限，行事作風亦都深思熟慮。不過，兩人嘅主要着眼點各有唔同。Ive一心想將硬件造到盡可能纖薄簡約，而Steve同樣執着於提供最佳嘅用戶體驗。

雖然Ive經常講設計遠遠唔止係外觀，但佢一直有個傾向重視外觀多過實用功能嘅名聲，結果就出咗好似蝴蝶鍵盤咁為人詬病嘅設計問題，而主流睇法係Steve生前一直發揮關鍵作用，遏止住呢種傾向。

據報Cook接任CEO之後，對公司設計團隊採取明顯更為放手嘅態度，大概每個月先去設計部一次。以Cook擅長營運同人事管理嘅背景嚟睇，咁做完全合理。

呢個唔係話Cook冇作出有用嘅貢獻，但佢太深入參與設計決定，尤其喺較早階段，可能會適得其反。特別係佢對成本嘅執着，可能會窒礙團隊嘅雄心。

相比之下，Ternus就徹頭徹尾係硬件人。佢喺擔任CEO之前，基本上已經接掌咗Ive原本硬件工程主管嘅職位；Apple亦都讚揚佢喺Ive離開公司之前，已經喺iPad同AirPods產品線嘅開發上扮演關鍵角色。

據講Ternus同Steve一樣，扭轉咗一啲為咗追求外觀靚而犧牲產品實用性嘅情況。雖然而家Molly Anderson同Steve Lemay嘅設計搭檔顯然非常有效，但呢個成功方程式其中一個要素，似乎就係Ternus嘅監督。

我個人就好高興聽到Ternus即使而家時間上分身不術，仍然繼續重視呢方面嘅工作。Anderson-Lemay-Ternus呢個組合合作得好，希望可以一直維持落去。
